description:
Manage SimplifyQA execution plans. Read plans with sqa_query (collection "executionPlans"). Pick ONE `action`:
- action:"create" — needs `name`, `plannedStartDate`, `plannedEndDate` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `environment` (name or key; see sqa_query collection "environments"). Optional: releaseId, sprintId, teamIds, planners, autoReExecCount, autoReExecTriggerOn, autoDefectLog, newBrowserSession, terminateOnFailure.
- action:"update" — needs `planId` and at least one field to change (same fields as create). AUTO DEFECT LOGGING for the plan = `autoDefectLog:true` (create or update): failed steps then log a defect automatically. It needs the project's admin "Auto Defect Logging" switch on; if it is off the call is refused with that instruction — tell the user to ask an admin to enable it, then retry.
- action:"delete" — needs `planId`. TWO-STEP: call without `confirm` to PREVIEW (nothing is deleted; it states what is permanently lost), show it to the user, and call again with `confirm:true` ONLY after the user explicitly says to delete.
- action:"add_testcases" - needs `planId` and `tcIds`, `testCases` and/or `suiteIds` (a suite adds its test cases). Optional `assignTo` (user id or "me") and `assignDate` (YYYY-MM-DD); only assigned test cases can run. To pin a VERSION pass `testCases:[{ tcId:"TC-12826", version:"v2.0" }]` (or `versionId`, or one `versionId`/`version` for every `tcIds` entry) — the same test case can sit in the plan once per version, so v1.0 and v2.0 are two entries. `version:"latest"` picks the NEWEST version (highest vMAJOR.MINOR). A version that does not exist is an ERROR; a duplicate (same test case AND version) is skipped and the reply says how to add the other version. With no version the test case's CURRENT one is added — not always the newest; the reply names the version added and warns when a newer one exists.
- action:"remove_testcases" — needs `planId` and `tcIds`. TWO-STEP like delete: removing also DELETES those test cases' run history in SimplifyQA, which cannot be undone.
- action:"stack_setup" — needs `planId` and `stacks` (how many, e.g. 2) or `stackConfigs`. Saves the Stack Setup (what the Stack canvas saves). Give `stacks` (a number: that many alike, test cases spread round-robin) OR `stackConfigs` (one entry per stack: its platform local / remote / cloud, browser, remote machine and, if the user says which, its test cases). `append:true` ADDS stacks to the saved setup instead of replacing it (existing stacks keep their platform; with no test cases named, all are re-spread over old + new). Every stack needs at least one test case, a REMOTE stack needs a machine, and CLOUD needs a cloud machine configured for the project. Run it afterwards with mode:"stack". Optional `stackMode` ("cloud" default | "local") and `browser` are the defaults for stacks that do not say. A planner of the plan can do this, not only an admin.
- action:"run" — needs `planId`; call ONLY when the user explicitly asked to run this plan. It runs NOW — SimplifyQA cannot schedule an execution plan (its Scheduler takes a test case or a suite). `mode`: "local" (default — this machine's agent, which must be running), "remote" (another machine's agent: pass `agentId`), "cloud" (the project's cloud machine) or "stack" (the saved Stack Setup, divided across its stacks; only the stacks holding test cases assigned to the person running it execute). Runs the assigned, non-blocked AUTOMATION test cases and says which were left out. Then track it with run_status({ runId }) — it lists each test case.
A plan in review or approval (REVIEW PENDING, APPROVE PENDING, REVIEWED, APPROVED) is read-only, as in SimplifyQA.

agentId.description: run: this machine's agent id (optional; auto-picked, see local_agents).

append.description: stack_setup: add the stack(s) to the saved setup instead of replacing it.

autoDefectLog.description: create/update: log a defect automatically when a step fails (needs the project's admin Auto Defect Logging switch on).

browser.description: stack_setup: browser for WEB test cases (default chrome). run, mode "cloud": the browser for the plan's web test cases — ONLY Chrome Headless, Firefox Headless or Edge Headless (pass chrome / firefox / edge). The run asks for it when a web test case has no saved cloud browser; never offer safari / webkit / chromium for the cloud.

confirm.description: delete: true on the SECOND call, only after the user explicitly said to delete.

mode.description: run: "local" (this machine's agent), "cloud" (a configured cloud machine), or "stack" (the saved stack setup, divided across its stacks).

name.description: create/update: plan name (unique in the project).

planId.description: Every action except create: plan id or code (PL-5).

plannedEndDate.description: create/update: YYYY-MM-DD, on or after the start.

stackConfigs.description: stack_setup: describe each stack, in order — one entry per stack (this sets the number of stacks; leave `stacks` out or make it match). E.g. [{ mode:"local" }, { mode:"cloud" }, { mode:"remote", agentId:"build-box-2" }].

agentId.description: REMOTE stacks only, required: the machine to run on — its id or machine name (see local_agents / remote_agents).

browser.description: Browser for the WEB test cases on this stack. LOCAL / REMOTE stacks: chrome, firefox, edge, safari (and their headless / incognito variants). A CLOUD stack offers ONLY Chrome Headless, Firefox Headless or Edge Headless — pass chrome / firefox / edge and it is that headless one; any other value is refused with those three. Default chrome (its headless one on a cloud stack).

mode.description: Where THIS stack runs (default: stackMode, else cloud).

testCases.description: Test cases (TC-39 or id) to put on THIS stack. Name them for every stack, or for none (then they are spread evenly).

stackMode.description: stack_setup: what each stack runs on (default cloud).

stacks.description: stack_setup: how many stacks (e.g. 2) — with append:true, how many to ADD. Omit when stackConfigs lists them.

suiteIds.description: add_testcases: suites whose test cases to add.

tcIds.description: add_testcases / remove_testcases: test case ids or codes.

testCases.description: add_testcases: test cases with an explicit version — lets one TC be added once per version (v1.0 AND v2.0).

tcId.description: Test case id or business key.

version.description: Pin this version NAME (e.g. "v2.0"), or "latest" for the newest; ignored when versionId is given.

versionId.description: Pin this version id (from the TC versions[]).

version.description: add_testcases: pin one version by NAME for every tcIds entry (e.g. v2.0), or "latest" for each test case's newest.

versionId.description: add_testcases: pin ONE version for every tcIds entry (id or name `version`). Omit = current version.

when.description: run: only "immediate" — execution plans cannot be scheduled in SimplifyQA.

name: execution_plan
title: Create, update or delete an execution plan (SimplifyQA)
